title: Is Safer Better? The Impact of Guardrails on the Argumentative Strength of LLMs in Hate Speech Countering
reasoning: The paper conducts an evaluation (benchmarking) of LLMs on the task of counterspeech generation, which is a moral and ethical domain aimed at mitigating hate speech. It specifically includes religion as a target category (17.1% of their dataset) and evaluates models using 'Suitableness' and 'Safety' metrics, testing them with prompts targeting religious groups such as Jews and Muslims.
